entry.title: New: dsh-python-env
entry.summary: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions. Exact install spec: dsh-python-env. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
